title: HOLON diagram sizes and obligation counts across targets (results/targets/sizes.json, holon-sizes/0.1; I49)
description: BUILD_PLAN I49/I50 exit: obligation counts against |E| and |V| across the four diagrams (toy, Morph M2, Morph M3, held-out), with no linearity claim from one target. The rows are the ones spec/M4/lib/heldout_protocol.json sizes.rows fixes, in that order. There is deliberately no field for a ratio, a slope, a fit or any other relation between the counts and the sizes: the form reports points, never a law over them.

linearity.const: not claimed: four diagrams and one held-out target support no claim about how obligation counts grow with |E| or |V|

pending.description: null when counted; else the key that will count them (I50 for the held-out row at I49)

total.description: laws of the law set whose facts document is the row's document

law_set_total.description: every law of the law set, over all its documents (context only)
